title: Emergency Teleport
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that adds an emergency teleport mechanic using Ender Pearls.
body:
# Emergency Teleport

A lightweight mod that lets you teleport to your respawn point using an Ender Pearl.

Avaliable for Minecraft 1.21.1

## Features
- **Teleport:** Use an Ender Pearl to return to your Bed, Respawn Anchor, or World Spawn.
- **Controls:** Hold an Ender Pearl and press **ALT + Right Click**.
- **Balanced:** Consumes 1 Ender Pearl per use and includes a 30-second cooldown.
- **Safe:** A confirmation GUI prevents accidental teleports.
- **Compatibility:** Works in the Overworld, Nether, and End.

## How to use
1. Hold an Ender Pearl in your main hand.
2. Press **ALT + Right Click**.
3. Confirm the action in the pop-up screen.
4. ESC closes the confirmation screen

## Requirements
- **Minecraft 1.21.1**
- **Fabric Loader**
- **Fabric API** (Required)
- This mod must be installed on both the client and the server.

Issues? Reach me on nogeviw363@gmail.com or open an issue on Github: https://github.com/nogeviw363/emergency-teleport/issues. The source code and the jar files are also there. 

Hope you enjoy :)
